source_caption_text:
Foogiano insists that he can’t represent 1017 after Gucci Mane cooperated in the Pooh Shiesty robbery and kidnapping investigation.

On Nov. 21, Foo was a guest on the Euroversity Podcast, where he talked about being released from prison earlier this year, new music and more. After previously revealing that his stint with 1017 is over, Foogiano said he can’t rock with Guwop after he confronted the 1017 head honcho over the phone about whether Gucci gave police information after allegedly being robbed and kidnapped by Pooh Shiesty and others back in January.
